body:
You enrolled on a twelve-week evening pottery class at an adult education centre and paid the full fee in advance. After five weeks the class was cancelled without any notice. When you arrived for your next lesson, the room was locked and a sign said the course had been withdrawn. You have not received a refund yet.

Write a letter to the manager of the adult education centre.
bullets: describe what happened on the evening the class was cancelled
explain how the cancellation has affected your plans
request a refund for the lessons you did not receive

body:
You moved into a university residence room three weeks ago. There is damp on the wall behind the wardrobe, and the window does not close properly in wet weather. You reported both problems through the online portal, but the only reply was an automated message saying your request had been logged.

Write a letter to the accommodation manager of the university.
bullets: give details of the problems and the dates you first noticed them
explain how the damp is affecting your belongings and your sleep
ask whether the room can be inspected or whether you can be moved

body:
You passed every assessment on an online course in project management, which finished eight months ago. The provider's website said a certificate would be emailed within six weeks of completion. Nothing has arrived, and your emails to the support address have gone unanswered for a month.

Write a letter to the customer support manager of the online training provider.
bullets: give your student number and the dates you completed the course
explain why you need the certificate for a job application
say what you would like the provider to do and by when

body:
From the start of this term, the school bus that serves your daughter's secondary school leaves 25 minutes earlier in the morning. Your daughter is twelve, and the new departure time means she has to wait at the stop in the dark. She has missed the bus twice this week, and other families on your road have the same problem.

Write a letter to the operations manager of the school bus company.
bullets: describe the change to the morning timetable
explain why the earlier departure is a problem for families
suggest a revised departure time or an extra stop on the route

body:
You have been offered a place on a master's programme in environmental engineering at a university abroad, but the tuition fees are more than you can pay. The foundation offers a scholarship that covers half the fees for students from low-income households, and you believe you meet its criteria. The closing date is next Friday.

Write a letter to the selection committee of the scholarship foundation.
bullets: give details of your academic results and your work since graduating
explain why the scholarship would make a difference to your plans
describe how you intend to use the skills you gain in your future career

body:
You booked a course of ten driving lessons with one particular instructor. In the last month she has cancelled four lessons at short notice, and each time a different instructor was sent instead. Your practical test is booked for next month, and you feel the constant changes have undermined your confidence.

Write a letter to the manager of the driving school.
bullets: describe the cancellations and how much notice you were given
explain why continuity with one instructor matters for your confidence
suggest a fair way to resolve the situation before your test

body:
You have taken photographs on holiday with a digital camera for about two years and would now like to improve your skills. A photography centre near you advertises a weekend course in landscape photography, but its website does not show the dates, the length of the course or the cost.

Write a letter to the course administrator at the photography centre.
bullets: ask when the next weekend course starts and how long it lasts
explain what level of experience the course is designed for
request a course outline and the total fee, including any equipment

body:
You are studying a business communication module on an online course, and your written assignment is due on Friday. A sudden change to your work rota has left you with almost no time to write it. Two classmates have already asked for an extension, and you would like to do the same.

Write a letter to your course tutor.
bullets: explain what has changed in your work schedule
ask whether the deadline can be moved by one week
say how you plan to make up the study time you have missed

body:
Your daughter's class is going on a day trip to a science museum next month. The letter sent home asks for a payment of £12, but your family is on a tight budget this term and you would like your daughter to be able to take part.

Write a letter to your child's teacher.
bullets: explain why the payment is difficult for your family at the moment
ask whether there is a support fund or a way to pay in instalments
confirm whether she will need a packed lunch and a signed form

body:
You have been having piano lessons with the same instructor for two years and have passed Grade 3. Recently the pieces you are given feel too easy, although you still find sight reading difficult. Your instructor believes your technique needs more work before you move up, and you are not sure whether to agree.

Write a letter to your music instructor.
bullets: describe the progress you have made since your first lesson
explain why you believe you are ready for Grade 4
suggest a way to check your readiness without giving up your current lessons

body:
You completed a research methods module with your lecturer two years ago and did well, although you rarely spoke in seminars. You are now applying for a research assistant post at a university laboratory, and the application asks for a reference from a previous lecturer. You are not certain how well she remembers your work.

Write a letter to your lecturer.
bullets: remind your lecturer of the project you completed in her module
explain why this laboratory post matches your research interests
ask whether she would be willing to write a reference before the closing date

body:
You are writing a master's dissertation on the use of green spaces in cities. Your fieldwork has been delayed because the council has withdrawn its permission to survey in two parks. Your submission date is in six weeks, and most of your data is still missing.

Write a letter to your supervisor.
bullets: explain what has caused the delay to your fieldwork
outline the changes you have made to your research plan
ask whether an extension to the submission date would be possible

body:
Your graduation ceremony is next month. Your best friend from your first year at university now lives in another city, and you have not seen them for almost two years. You would really like them to be there.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: tell your friend the date, time and place of the ceremony
invite your friend to celebrate with your family afterwards
say whether you can help with a place to stay nearby

body:
A close friend has just started driving lessons, after years of avoiding the idea. You passed your own driving test last year, and you remember how nervous you felt during your first few weeks on the road.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: congratulate your friend on finally starting lessons
offer to practise with them in a quiet car park
suggest a few tips that helped you during your own lessons

body:
Last month your course took you on a week-long study trip to a city abroad, where you visited a university library and a language school. Your friend could not come because of work, and they have missed hearing about it.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: describe the places you visited and which one you found most useful
tell your friend about the accommodation and the local food
explain why you think your friend should join the trip next year

body:
Your friend has agreed to help you prepare for a Spanish speaking test in June, but you have only met twice this term because you are both very busy. You feel your speaking has become rusty, and you want to make the most of the time you have left before the exam.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: ask whether your friend could meet once a week for an hour
suggest a few topics you would like to practise, such as travel and work
confirm the date and time of your test

body:
A friend who runs a weekly language exchange group in the evenings has invited you to join. You would enjoy it, but you are about to start a demanding evening course and cannot commit to every week. Your friend has put a lot of effort into organising the group, and you do not want to let them down.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: thank your friend for the invitation and explain your situation
describe what you would still like to get from the group
suggest another way you could help or take part
